subject.title: feat(matrix): add configurable read receipt timing

question: Should OpenClaw expose the full per-account `immediate`/`on-reply`/`off` Matrix receipt contract, or should this PR be narrowed to a smaller opt-in policy?
rationale: This is a new user-facing configuration and account-override API, not a repair of an established contract; the linked feature request is explicitly awaiting maintainer direction.

options.title: Approve the full per-account contract
options.body: Keep all three modes and account overrides, but require upgrade-safe validation or a doctor migration before landing.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Keep only the channel-level opt-in behavior that maintainers want to support now and defer account overrides or the `off` mode.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Leave the proposal open until Matrix configuration policy is prioritized by an owner.

recommendation.title: Approve the full per-account contract
recommendation.body: Keep all three modes and account overrides, but require upgrade-safe validation or a doctor migration before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current concrete proposal and have offered to narrow it after maintainer direction.
